title: Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) REMS Bundle
publisher: NASA Planetary Data System, Atmospheres Node (atmos.nmsu.edu)
authors: Jose A. Rodriguez-Manfredi; Manuel de la Torre Juarez (Centro de Astrobiologia)
version: Bundle version 1.0, modified 2026-08-03; the environmental RDR data set MSL-M-REMS-4-ENVRDR-V1.0, release 0037. The seven files read here are the RNV products for sols 4182 and 4187-4192.
credit: Rodriguez-Manfredi, J. A., and de la Torre Juarez, M. (2026), Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) REMS Bundle, version 1.0, NASA Planetary Data System, Atmospheres Node, doi:10.17189/vwva-ms24. The app reads the air temperature, ground temperature and pressure columns of the named RNV files and reports the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of each 5 degree L_s bin; no figure or text is reproduced from the files.
licence: The bundle's collection metadata and the labels of the files read here state no licence. The Planetary Data System's data-use policy (https://www.pds.nasa.gov/pds/pds.use) applies to the archive's contents.
accuracy_note: The seven files read here cover sols 4182 and 4187-4192 only (the storm window around sol 4190), not a full climatology; the bins are 5 degrees of areocentric solar longitude. Each file's SHA-256 is recorded in pipeline/work/rems/SOURCES.md. The L_s of each sample is derived from the label's start and stop times with the Allison and McEwen (2000) equations, the same source the app's Mars24 Sunclock uses.
